property_summary: For any nonempty recipient array and any forwarding address, C.transfer always returns true and does not revert itself, even when the forwarded transferFrom calls fail.
C.transfer with a single-element recipient array always returns true and never reverts, because each low-level transferFrom call's failure is ignored.
For any nonempty recipient array and any forwarding address, C.transfer always returns true and does not revert, regardless of whether the forwarded calls succeed.
C.transfer always returns true for any nonempty recipient array, regardless of the forwarded calls' success.
C.transfer always returns true for any nonempty recipient array, regardless of the forwarded calls' success.
C.transfer always returns true, and this return value is preserved by every call.
If the called contract reverts on every transferFrom, then C.transfer still returns true.
For a single-element transfer list, C.transfer always returns true.
For any single-element transfer list, C.transfer returns true regardless of the recipient contract’s behavior.
For any non-empty recipient list, C.transfer always returns true, regardless of the transfer outcomes.
